posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@hemalatha @sayan @Afnan_POD

This is my Re Oppe term for System Commands.

In this term I have to only give OPPE and BPT again according to grading document, what to do about the Weekly Graded Assignments being displayed in my course portal.

  1. Do I have to solve and submit the graded assignments again ??

  2. Will solving Graded Assignments again update my marks ?

Please clarify the above two queries.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You do not have to attempt anything other than BPT and OPPE.

BPT is for OPPE eligibilty, but last term BPT scores will be taken for final score.

GA is carried over from last term.

posts.name: Avilekh Baruah
posts.cooked:
Hi Sayan,
Hope you’re doing well. I had a quick query regarding BPT—do we need to resubmit all the answers, or would it suffice to simply run the Synchro Eval on the responses we submitted in the recent term?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If questions are same and solutions are correct, synchro eval is enough.
